reports.title: Reports
reports.loadError: Could not load the report data.
reports.note: Every figure refers to the chosen period: tasks created in it, completed in it, and due in it. Overdue means due in the period, past the due date and not done. Cancelled tasks are left out. The unfinished list holds tasks due in the period and, when they have no due date, tasks created in it. The delay is counted in days against the due date: up to the completion day for completed tasks, up to today for unfinished ones.
